concurrency: Single-threaded caller-driven execution; no service, daemon, thread or network is created.
dependencies: accepted xverse_xdl.experiment_plan public API/digest semantics (read-only, unchanged)
accepted C++ X-COM observation contract 1.0.0 (read-only, unchanged)
deployment: Offline, in-process Python library and console entry point inside the admitted ARGUS2 envelope: no process, service, container, network, device, provider handle, live tap, registry or oracle is created, started, probed or contacted.
rationale: Source allocation from docs/engineering/argus-lite/requirements.md ARGUS2-SR-011, realized by ARGUS2-ARCH-11/ARGUS2-ARCH-05 in docs/engineering/argus-lite/architecture.md section 4 and frozen in docs/engineering/argus-lite/detailed-design.md.
responsibilities: Require the caller to supply the run identity, clock identities/units, finite limits and evidence obligations.
Operate offline on JSON/JSONL only, with no implicit wall clock, no random identity, no remote lookup and no cross-clock conversion.
Acquire no network service, dashboard, extra dependency or runtime service, no metrics computation, no control or actuation authority, no live tap bridge and no evaluation oracle.
Reject or omit any attempt to rely on an implicit clock/identity/limit, a remote lookup, or a control, metric-computation or oracle capability.
state_ownership: Owns only the caller-supplied authority values (identity, clocks, limits, obligations) and the offline run root.
title: ARGUS2-SR-011-CMP allocation - Caller authority, offline operation and absence of control authority
